name: Gravebane Ammunition (Greater)
text:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
First made to deal with a wicked necromancer's encroaching horde, gravebane ammunition is crafted with materials soaked in blessed waters. On a successful Strike, the attack deals an additional 2d10 vitality damage to creatures with void healing. If the target takes vitality damage, it must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save save or become Enfeebled 1 (or Enfeebled 2 on a critical failure) until the start of your next turn.
